Track three
Help it hear you
Small habits, fewer typos

Read it before you send it

Do
  • Hold the phone near your mouth
  • Say names slowly
  • Skim the text before sending
Avoid
  • Dictating next to traffic
  • Bank numbers out loud in public
  • Sending without a quick look
